assumptions.statement: The submitted SITE_BOUNDARY and three KEY_AREA polygons are provisional constraints; detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, heritage conditions, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package supports formal AI concept review through traceable design layers and recalculated indicators, but it does not establish a statutory redline, approved FAR, building height, final ownership, municipal capacity, or guaranteed implementation path.

assumptions.statement: AI+ scenarios are designed as open, reversible test cases using public or cleared data and human review; no private personal data or mandatory supplier is assumed.
assumptions.impact: Scenario operation requires a separately approved data-governance, privacy, safety, procurement, and public-participation protocol.

assumptions.statement: The three-phase geometry is an ordering diagram for light-touch pilots, public-space upgrades, and later renewal coordination rather than a committed construction schedule.
assumptions.impact: Funding, ownership, approvals, relocation, infrastructure capacity, and maintenance responsibilities may change the sequence after professional review.

assumptions.statement: Large-area narrative display uses ha and local element display uses m²; machine-readable geometry and metrics retain area unit sqm and length unit m.
assumptions.impact: Unit conversion must be reapplied after official geometry replacement; narrative values do not override metrics.json.

assumptions.statement: AI+ scenarios are designed with offline alternatives, human service, opt-out, complaint, and accessibility paths; no personal data is required for the concept to operate.
assumptions.impact: A future pilot requires a documented privacy impact review, accessibility review, data-retention policy, and public grievance process.

assumptions.statement: Six global ecosystem cases are public background references used to compare transferable mechanisms; none is evidence of a local partnership, investment, policy, or implementation commitment.
assumptions.impact: Official pages and current operating conditions must be rechecked by the professional and operations teams before any local adaptation.

assumptions.statement: Submitted text, figures, SVG direction, PDF boards, and offline HTML are generated for this package; repository data and cleared taskbook material remain attributed to their recorded sources.
assumptions.impact: Any future external logo, font, map, photograph, icon, dataset, or trademark requires a new asset-level rights review before reuse.
